checks.observation: All 281 local import edges point to earlier packaged modules; the only unpackaged imports are Lean or Mathlib modules covered by the stated external dependency requirement. checks.method: Independently evaluated min(floor(9q/2), floor((168−5q)/3)) for every integer q from zero through twelve, and checked the positive-coefficient elimination in Section 3.2 against TwoHighIncidence.lean.
checks.observation: The largest allowed residual size is forty, attained by the inequalities only at q=9; q=10 gives at most39 and q=12 at most36. The elimination gives 37m≤1512, whereas m=41 would require1517. Thus no real-to-integer rounding, endpoint case or natural-subtraction convention weakens the claimed m≤40. This check concerns the proven inequalities, not the unproved stronger cap45 diagnostic.

content.summary: The portable source order is consistent with all local imports, and the recorded audit runs are tied to the packaged audit-source bytes. An independent integer calculation confirms that the incidence inequalities exclude every residual cardinality above forty for all possible overlap sizes. These checks support reproducibility and the sharp rounding step while preserving the disclosed same-evaluator and external-I(27) limits.
